info.title: BibleResearch API
info.description: Database-native research API for original-language Hebrew/Aramaic Old Testament and Greek New Testament Scriptures, canonical lexical/morphological/syntax evidence, context-aware biblical chronology, and evidence-based biblical geography. All research prompts, deterministic lexical lookups, and context resolvers run directly in PostgreSQL via Supabase PostgREST RPC endpoints with zero client-side join overhead or AI sense inference.

post.summary: Retrieve ordered original-language tokens for a verse (Prompt 1)
post.description: Prompt 1: Returns ordered original-language words/tokens for a specific Bible passage. Tokens include word position, database word ID, Hebrew/Aramaic/Greek text, transliteration, Strong's number, morphology grammar code, primary English translation gloss, and millennium index. Canonical books are numbered 1 (Genesis) to 66 (Revelation). Verse 0 represents Psalm headings.

p_verse.description: Verse number within the chapter (0 for Psalm heading)

200.description: List of ordered tokens in the requested verse

post.summary: Find all verse occurrences of a word across the Bible (Prompt 2)
post.description: Prompt 2: Finds all passages containing a specific lexical word across all its inflections and forms using GIN indexing. Groups inflections by Strong's number. Returns book, chapter, verse_nr, millennium, and occurrence count within that verse.

p_word_query.description: Word identifier: Strong's number (e.g. 'H7225' or 'G3056'), positive integer word ID (e.g. '129386'), exact original script ('בְּרֵאשִׁית'), or transliteration ('bereshit')

200.description: List of verses where the word occurs with occurrence counts

post.summary: Find top co-occurring lexical partners for a word (Prompt 3)
post.description: Prompt 3: Returns the top cached co-occurring lexical partners for a word, ranked by statistical association score. Includes co-occurring word ID, Strong's number, original script, transliteration, primary English gloss, association score, co-occurrence frequency, and average token distance.

p_word_query.description: Word identifier: Strong's number (e.g. 'H7225' or 'G3056'), positive integer word ID, exact original script, or transliteration

200.description: List of top co-occurring words with association statistics

post.summary: Calculate cross-verse relationship density for multiple words (Prompt 4)
post.description: Prompt 4: Finds all verses where two or more specified words co-occur and computes a relationship density score based on verse length and word co-presence. Requires positive integer word IDs (which can be obtained via resolve_word_id or prompt_verse_words).

p_word_ids.description: Array of positive integer word IDs to evaluate shared verse co-presence. Example: [129386, 79640]

200.description: List of verses containing all target words, ordered by relationship density score

post.summary: Resolve a query string to a canonical database word ID
post.description: Helper RPC: Resolves a Strong's number (e.g. 'H7225' or 'G3056'), transliteration, original script form, or numeric string to a single positive database integer word ID. Useful for preparing word ID arguments for prompt_word_relationships.

p_query.description: Strong's number (e.g. 'H7225'), original script, transliteration, or numeric ID

200.description: Resolved canonical database word ID, or null if not found

post.summary: Retrieve multi-model historical and composition chronology for a verse (Prompt 5)
post.description: Prompt 5: Returns a structured JSON packet containing historical event chronology, composition dating, archaeological/textual evidence, and competing chronological models (e.g., 'theographic-verse-v1', 'creation-am-v1', 'thiele-mcfall-v1', 'textual-witness-v1') for any Bible verse. Never fabricates precise dates for timeless wisdom or symbolic apocalyptic passages.

p_verse.description: Verse number within the chapter (0 for Psalm heading)

p_evidence_cursor.description: Optional cursor for paginating chronology evidence

200.description: Structured chronological context packet for the requested verse

post.summary: Retrieve context-aware biblical geography and scholarly identifications for a verse (Prompt 6)
post.description: Prompt 6: Resolves where the events described in a verse occurred using a deterministic 5-tier hierarchy (direct event setting, narrative passage context, Theographic event metadata, regional inference, or symbolic/unknown). Distinguishes event settings from mentioned places, travel origins, and travel destinations, and returns coordinates, polygons, confidence scores, scholarly evidence, and disputed alternative identifications.

p_verse.description: Verse number within the chapter (0 for Psalm heading)

200.description: Structured geographical context packet for the requested verse

post.summary: Retrieve one-lookup disambiguated lexemes, narrative parallels, allusions, and controls (Prompt 7)
post.description: Prompt 7: Resolves words, concepts, or Strong's numbers in one PostgreSQL call, returning disambiguated lexemes (including homograph subdivisions), reviewed literary/intertextual evidence paths, counterexample controls, and corpus co-occurrence statistics.

200.description: Structured relationship research packet

post.summary: Read ordered source English and private occurrence choices
post.description: Public reads return source renderings. A user access token restores only that reader’s private choices. Alternatives preserve the exact original form and grammar; they are observed STEP renderings, not an exhaustive dictionary.

200.description: Successful response

403.description: Access denied by ownership or grants

post.summary: Save a private translation for one verse occurrence
post.description: Requires a Supabase Auth user access token (anonymous sign-in users are supported). The owner is derived from auth.uid(); callers cannot supply an owner ID. Invalid rendering or occurrence is rejected.

200.description: Successful response

403.description: Access denied by ownership or grants

post.summary: Restore the source translation for one verse occurrence
post.description: Requires a Supabase Auth user access token (anonymous sign-in users are supported). The owner is derived from auth.uid(); callers cannot supply an owner ID. Invalid rendering or occurrence is rejected.

200.description: Successful response

403.description: Access denied by ownership or grants

post.summary: Hydrate 1-5 verses for AI research in one JSON response
post.description: Ordered tokens, public source renderings, Strong's, grammar, definitions, full occurrence references/counts, seven ranked cached connections per base Strong's, chronology, map data and available reviewed semantic evidence. Shared lexical_entries avoid duplication. Inspect coverage, component statuses and homograph ambiguity. Full occurrences are the default; samples are explicit. Errors never silently truncate an oversized packet (8 MiB cap). Private translation choices are excluded.

200.description: Hydrated packet or explicit validation/size error

post.summary: Authoritative lexical semantics lookup (F5)
post.description: Multi-tier Unicode-aware lexical semantics resolving canonical lemmas, homographs, documented roots (non-synonymous invariant), documented lexical senses (with definition text, scripture citations, and source attribution), and attested translation glosses with contextual equivalence caveats.

p_query.description: Search query: Hebrew/Aramaic (with or without niqqud), Greek (monotonic or polytonic), Strong's code, or transliteration

p_match_scope.description: Matching scope: auto, lemma, surface, or root

200.description: Structured lexical semantics response with strict separation of lemma, root, sense, and gloss

post.summary: Deterministic lookup: surface word form -> canonical lemma(s) -> available lexical senses
post.description: Decomposes an inflected original-language word form (by word_id or query string) into ordered morpheme-lemma links (prefixes, stem, suffixes) and returns all cataloged lexical senses without AI contextual sense inference.

p_query.description: Optional original-script form, Strong's number, or transliteration

200.description: Word-form morpheme decomposition and cataloged lexical senses

post.summary: Deterministic lookup: canonical lemma -> all biblical occurrences across inflected forms
post.description: Resolves a canonical lemma (by lemma_key, Strong's code, script, or transliteration), preserves homograph candidates when ambiguous, and returns cursor-paginated corpus occurrences across all inflected surface forms.

p_lemma_query.description: Canonical lemma_key (e.g. lemma:G3056, lemma:H1254a), Strong's number, script, or transliteration

p_after_verse_id.description: Cursor verse_id for deterministic keyset pagination

200.description: Lemma occurrences packet with homograph candidates and keyset cursor

post.summary: Deterministic lookup: canonical lemma -> documented lexical roots and root relatives
post.description: Returns documented lexical roots and co-derived/cognate lemmas from pinned lexicons with explicit implies_synonymy=false invariant and zero root-meaning conflation.

p_lemma_query.description: Canonical lemma_key, Strong's number, script, or transliteration

200.description: Documented lexical roots and non-synonymous root relatives

post.summary: Deterministic lookup: canonical lemma -> lexicon sense glosses vs attested corpus renderings
post.description: Separates cataloged lexicon sense glosses from attested interlinear English renderings aggregated across biblical occurrences, keeping sense definitions distinct from contextual English translations.

p_lemma_query.description: Canonical lemma_key, Strong's number, script, or transliteration

200.description: Separated lexicon sense glosses and attested English rendering counts

post.summary: Deterministic lookup: biblical passage -> edition refs, versification mappings, tokens, morphology & syntax
post.description: Returns edition-specific passage identifiers, documented versification mappings (e.g. Hebrew Psalm superscriptions vs English numbering), ordered tokens with sub-word morpheme decompositions, syntax nodes/edges, and semantic annotations.

200.description: Passage tokens, morphemes, versification mappings, syntax graph, and semantic annotations

post.summary: Deterministic lookup: concept -> documented external properties and hyperlinks
post.description: Returns external factual properties (coordinates, ISO dates, people/place metadata) and external authority links (Wikidata, Pleiades) with explicit epistemic_layer separation.

p_concept_query.description: Concept key, title, alias, or Strong's code

200.description: Concept record(s) with documented external properties and authority links

post.summary: Deterministic lookup: canonical entity -> directly documented or deterministically calculated relationships
post.description: Resolves any canonical entity (lemma, root, sense, word_form, passage, concept, place, event) and returns provenance-complete outgoing and incoming evidence relationships.

p_entity_query.description: Canonical entity_key (e.g. lemma:G3056, root:G3056, passage:PSA.3.0, concept:LAMPSTAND) or display label/alias

200.description: Provenance-complete entity relationships

post.summary: Forward lookup: Hebrew lemma to Greek translation equivalents
post.description: Returns explicit source-provided Greek translation equivalents for a Hebrew lemma from MACULA Hebrew, with alignment frequencies, sample verses, and provenance. Gated by field_license_registry.

p_lemma_query.description: Hebrew lemma, Strong number (e.g. H0430, 430), or entity key (lemma:H0430G)

200.description: Hebrew-to-Greek translation alignments

post.summary: Reverse lookup: Greek lemma to Hebrew lemmas rendered
post.description: Returns Hebrew lemmas rendered by a given Greek lemma in ancient translation, with occurrence frequencies, sample verses, and provenance.

p_greek_query.description: Greek lemma, Strong number (e.g. G2316, 2316), or entity key (lemma:G2316)

200.description: Greek-to-Hebrew translation alignments

post.summary: Side-by-side Masoretic Hebrew and Septuagint Greek parallel text
post.description: Returns parallel Masoretic Hebrew tokens and Swete Septuagint Greek tokens for a verse, handling Psalms versification shifts (e.g. Psalm 3:0 title vs LXX 3:1) and morpheme-level alignment links.

200.description: Parallel MT Hebrew and Swete LXX Greek text

post.summary: Cross-testament Greek vocabulary tracing across LXX and NT
post.description: Traces Greek vocabulary across the Septuagint (Swete) and New Testament Greek, showing frequency distributions and underlying Hebrew renderings.

p_greek_query.description: Greek lemma, Strong number (e.g. G2316), or inflected form

200.description: Cross-testament Greek occurrences and Hebrew renderings

apiKeyHeader.name: apikey
apiKeyHeader.description: Supabase anonymous API key for public access

bearerAuth.description: Supabase Bearer token (anon key or user JWT)

original_word.description: Hebrew, Aramaic, or Greek text with pointing/accents

occurrence_count.description: Number of times the word appears in this specific verse

word_id.description: Canonical database word ID of the co-occurring word

strongs_nr.description: Strong's number of the co-occurring word

original_word.description: Original language script of the co-occurring word

transliteration.description: Phonetic transliteration of the co-occurring word

primary_english.description: English gloss of the co-occurring word

score.description: Statistical association score between the two words

frequency.description: Frequency of co-occurrence across the corpus

avg_distance.description: Average word token distance in verses where they co-occur

occurrences.description: Default all includes every occurrence reference and exact counts. Explicit sample mode limits references only; totals remain exact. limit is valid only with sample.
